description: Nails gives up the safehouse once pressured as the weak link.

nodes.speaker: nails
nodes.text: If Big Boss sent you, I already know this ends badly.

options.text: He did not. But he did make it clear you are the one who breaks first.

nodes.speaker: nails
nodes.text: Damn it. Fine. Safehouse off the old service road. Metal door, no sign, no second chance if you hesitate.
